limitations: This is ten biome material sets, not every possible biome or an original map reconstruction
No inner/concave corners, complete terrain-to-terrain transition matrix, full shoreline slopes, elevation set, seasons or auto-tiling rules are supplied
Earlier straight atlas dividers and mountain edge endcaps were corrected and archived; dense patterns, repetition and join discontinuities remain review findings
Collision bounds are suggestions only; no physics, trigger, navigation, TileBase or RuleTile assets are created
Vehicle views are static directional states, not animation sequences
The fantasy propeller-plane is an optional extension
